decisions.id: D2: European experiments not cited
decisions.summary: Mannering 2021 and Bender Jorgensen 2012 are omitted on two grounds: research/CLAUDE.md's comparative exception does not cover craft-time rates, and wool on a warp-weighted loom says nothing about hemp splicing or cotton; the omission is said in the reply.
decisions.why: The request's Q3 says 'a measured modern craft rate is acceptable as a COMPARATIVE source where no period figure exists', its region order 'Europe or modern experiment as comparison only', and its leads name 'measured craft and experimental-archaeology rates for spinning and weaving'; FR-001 places 'a Europe or modern-experiment figure' in Comparative money under research/CLAUDE.md 'Comparative money sources'. Ground 1 contradicts FR-001 and the GM's words directly: the accepted spec already settled that this class of figure goes in exactly that section. Ground 2 is a relevance argument the GM pre-empted: 'comparison only' already concedes a different fiber and loom, and the trigger condition is met by the plan's own finding that hemp and silk per tan are SILENT - the case the permission was written for. The plan turns 'comparison only' into 'not at all'; saying so in the reply is disclosure, not legitimacy. Fix: cite them in Comparative money, tagged subject=comparative,money, labeled wool on a warp-weighted loom, as comparison for the SILENT hemp and silk stages - or, if the session holds that no measured modern rate bears on any of the three fibers, name the search for one (hemp, ramie, cotton, silk, not only European wool) and record its SILENT.

decisions.id: D3: city households and days off
decisions.summary: Edo rice polishers, Bunsei budgets, bath fees, the shared well, used clothing, water sellers, washing shops; home-work days single vs family SILENT; the journalist's unsourced contrast 'given as that or left out'; rental shops a lead only; China SILENT beyond Beijing water carriers; Q5 extends 0311 with merchant-house yabuiri; porters, guards, footmen SILENT.
decisions.why: Answers Q4 and Q5 in the requested order; SILENT results are findings. The 'given as that or left out' line is an undecided either/or on the very contrast Q4 asks about - not a narrowing, but it should be decided (given, labeled unsourced) rather than left open.

decisions.id: D3a: Q4's list of what a city household bought, and what each cost
decisions.summary: Plan carries polished rice, the Bunsei budgets (firewood priced with seasonings, 58 monme), bath fees, used cotton clothing, water sellers, washing shops; used clothing, water and washing are named as trades with no price and no SILENT; cooked food has no entry beyond a child's sweets (rice, miso and soy are ingredients); mending has no entry at all
decisions.why: Q4 asks verbatim 'What did they buy that a farm household made (used clothing, cooked food, washing, mending, firewood, water), and what did each cost?', and its figure needed is 'the trades that sold these services and goods, their prices'. Of the six items only firewood is priced. Used clothing, washing and water appear as trades with neither price nor SILENT (the only SILENT on washing is whose clothes); cooked food has no entry beyond a child's sweets; mending has none. Nothing makes those answers impossible to report - at worst they are SILENT with the searches - so this is a narrowing by omission, the same one D1's task list had and has now fixed. Fix: carry each of Q4's six items with its trade and its price, or SILENT with the searches, as D1 now does item by item for Q2's starting list.
